# BuildVoiceAI

> For the complete reference, see [llms-full.txt](https://buildvoiceai.com/llms-full.txt)

> BuildVoiceAI is an AI voice agent platform for agencies and businesses. Users describe what they want their phone agent to do in plain English, and the platform generates, deploys, and manages the agent — including voice selection, call scripts, phone number provisioning, and post-call CRM automation. No coding required.

## What it does

BuildVoiceAI covers four core workflows:

- **Build**: Describe your agent in natural language. The system generates the conversation flow, selects a voice, and configures the phone number. Test it with a call, then go live.
- **Monitor**: View call volume, success rates, costs, and duration in a unified dashboard. Click any call to read the full transcript or listen to the recording.
- **Automate**: Post-call workflows automatically update CRM contacts, create deals, book appointments, and send follow-ups. Integrates natively with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Calendly, and Slack.
- **Scale**: White-label the entire platform for agency clients. Clients get a branded dashboard — your logo, your domain, their data only. They never see BuildVoiceAI branding.

## Voice providers

Four providers are supported: Retell AI, Vapi, Bland, and ElevenLabs. Agents can run A/B experiments across providers to find the best performer. All voices use neural models and sound natural and conversational.

## Integrations

- CRM: GoHighLevel, HubSpot
- Calendars: Calendly, Google Calendar
- Notifications: Slack
- Phone numbers: Purchase directly through the platform, or sync numbers already in your voice provider account

## Pricing

All plans start with a 7-day free trial, no credit card required. Plans are priced by number of clients, and every plan includes unlimited agents. Self-Service plans use your own provider API keys (you pay the provider for minutes) or platform keys at $0.15/min. Managed plans are done-for-you and run on platform keys at $0.15/min. Extra clients are billed per client. Annual billing saves 2 months.

- **Self-Service Starter — $67/month**: 3 clients ($15/extra), AI agent builder, call analytics, workflow automation, email support.
- **Self-Service Growth — $147/month**: 10 clients ($12/extra), adds GoHighLevel/HubSpot integrations, Stripe Connect client billing, white-label and custom domains, A/B experiments.
- **Self-Service Agency — $297/month**: 25 clients ($10/extra), adds API access and priority support.
- **Managed Starter — $97/month**: 3 clients ($20/extra), done-for-you agent setup, priority support.
- **Managed Growth — $197/month**: 10 clients ($17/extra), adds done-for-you integrations, CRM integrations, Stripe Connect, white-label and custom domains.
- **Managed Agency — $397/month**: 25 clients ($15/extra), done-for-you white-label setup, API access, dedicated support.

## Common use cases

Dental receptionist (appointment booking, insurance questions), real estate lead qualification, sales follow-up calling, customer support with human escalation, after-hours call handling.

## Security

All data is encrypted at rest and in transit. Call recordings and transcripts are scoped per account with row-level security. Customer data is never used to train AI models.
